title: Masai Mara: African Wildlife Stories
desc: The wildlife of the Maasai Mara reveals the raw beauty and realities of one of the most untamed lands, highlighting the daily struggle for survival and the balance between predator and prey.

title: Amur, Asia's Amazon
desc: The Amur or Heilongjiang, as it is called in China, is one of the planet's ten mightiest rivers, yet it is hardly known to westerners.

title: The Big Dry
desc: The Luangwa Valley in Zambia experiences one of the toughest dry seasons imaginable.

title: Big Cat Tales
desc: A dispersed Marsh Pride faces weakened protection from the six male warrior lions. Plus, a cheetah works tirelessly to raise her three new cubs.

title: Tiger On The Run
desc: Follow a young tiger in India that has been forced out of its home territory by another male and has to struggle for survival.

desc: Human-wildlife conflict is prevalent across Africa. To mitigate conflicts, Ivan joins Roger Whittall to collar bull elephants to create an early warning system for surrounding communities.

title: Texas Gator Savers
desc: Gary, Arlie, and Damon rescue two huge gators: one near a restaurant and the other at an industrial equipment supplier, all while the team gets Gator Country ready for the busiest day of the year.

desc: Filmed over ten years, an in-depth look at the leopard characters of South Africa and their fascinating unfolding story once their Queen dies.

desc: Arid and unforgiving, deserts push their inhabitants to the extreme. From the desert elephant to the shovel-snouted lizard, see how they survive.

desc: Patrick Aryee explores the crucial role played by grizzly bears, sperm whales, and anacondas.

desc: Known as Heilongjiang, meaning the Black Dragon, the Amur forms a natural border between Russia and China and has become a haven for wetlands and wildlife.

desc: We examine how animals have evolved over the course of time and analyse how we can benefit from their evolution.

desc: Jungle life is examined. Insects, reptiles, mammals, fish and birds strike with speed.

desc: Dianne finds a boomslang and a chameleon in a duel on the tar road.
